performance_case.causal_mechanism: A long-only reversal accumulator can mistake a discontinuous price shock for a completed reversal. Realized variance includes both continuous and discontinuous variation, while bipower variation is comparatively robust to rare jumps; their relative ratio tests whether unusually jumpy complete-day paths identify fragile entries before the unchanged next-open fill without changing direction, total-volatility level, exits or size.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one post-hoc pre-2025 historical mechanism conclusion for exact same-equity DRA V1 with versus without DAILY_REALIZED_TO_BIPOWER_VARIATION_RATIO_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN admission. Historical Validation is not clean OOS and the H1 ratio is not a formal jump detector. A positive result retains a prior for at most one separately frozen hypothesis; it is not independent alpha, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization. The task cannot inspect post-2024 outcomes, change a threshold, lookback, return convention, formula, runner or gate, create a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy or mutate canonical state.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The feature is valuable only if it avoids shock-driven false reversals without merely suppressing participation or moving losses into terminal inventory. The frozen equal-capital screen therefore requires PnL breadth, drawdown non-inferiority, holding tails, underwater duration, utilization, realized-lot support and neighbor stability together.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The veto can miss profitable post-jump continuation or overreaction reversals, and H1 sampling can confuse volatility bursts with jumps. One frozen screen either retains the proxy for one future hypothesis or closes it before tick-data, alternate jump tests, OOS or runtime work consumes research capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Under identical 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity and unchanged DRA V1 economics, admitting signals only when the latest complete day's realized-to-bipower jumpiness ratio is at or below 1.0 of its prior-20-day median will improve fee-adjusted total PnL in Design and historical Validation while preserving realized and unrealized components and maintaining acceptable drawdown, holding, underwater, annual-breadth and concentration paths.
